role: Curator-only design reference, not a runtime dependency or solver-visible source.
verified_behavior: new_context requests a transition without generating a summary or resetting environment state.
Session loop consumes the request after sampling/tools and installs a new context window.
History/notes extension exposes bounded retrieval, opaque window/item IDs, and virtual note paths.
Public extension forwards storage operations to Codex backend endpoints; backend implementation is not present in these files.
task_adaptations: Local Pi persistence and API-key provider compatibility.
Single session scope; no cross-agent addressing.
Six flat tool names with an explicit local JSON contract.
Retain user messages and latest summary.md automatically.
Immediate local consistency and restart persistence.
No encrypted/model-only transport, automatic token budget policy, or multimodal history.
